name: Reading Sheet Music for Beginners
equipment: A piano or keyboard and sheet music (optional)
instructions: Piano music is typically written on two staves: the treble clef (usually right hand) and bass clef (usually left hand).
Learn to recognize middle C's position on the staff -- it is the anchor point both clefs are built around.
You do not need to sight-read fluently to keep enjoying piano, but recognizing basic notation will help you learn new songs faster.
Watch today's video for an introduction to reading sheet music.
